item.title: Government announces rules for permitted group fireworks after ban comes into effect
item.description: To set off fireworks on New Year’s Eve, individuals must get municipal permission as part of a registered group.

item.title: Hundreds of Dutch travelers defrauded as hackers hijack Booking.com accounts
item.description: A major security breach at Booking.com has left hundreds of Dutch travelers defrauded, as hackers gained access to hotel accounts and sent fake messages to guests,

item.title: Unions report aggression against Schiphol staff during snow-related disruptions
item.description: Schiphol staff faced aggression and intimidation last week amid flight cancellations and delays caused by snow, the FNV union said.

item.title: 840 wolf attacks on livestock last year; 90% of affected farmers didn't have fencing
item.description: The number of wolf attacks on sheep and other livestock in the Netherlands increased significantly last year.

item.title: Noord-Brabant hospital performs first human 3D-printed hip implant
item.description: A 36-year-old man suffering from hip dysplasia received a 3D-printed hip implant at the Anna Hospital in Geldrop, Noord-Brabant, on Friday.

item.title: Video: Motorist, 54, dies after crashing into Heerlen hospital
item.description: A 54-year-old man from Kerkrade died after he crashed his car into a building of the Zuyderland hospital in Heerlen on Thursday evening.

item.title: Dutch parcel deliverers publicly shamed online, raising privacy concerns
item.description: Parcel deliverers in the Netherlands are increasingly being publicly shamed in large Facebook groups, according to PostNL and DHL.

item.title: Amsterdam payment startup Klearly raises €12 million in investments
item.description: Amsterdam start-up Klearly, which provides payment solutions for the hospitality sector, has secured 12 million euros in fresh investment.

item.title: 530 denied entry as Dutch border checks complete year of inspections
item.description: Over the course of a year of border inspections, authorities refused entry to 530 individuals.
